subject: SOC 2 Type II — targeted extracts and bridge letter request
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@starlithealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@starlithealth.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + targeted control extracts

Hi Jonas,

As part of our vendor assessment for the platform rollout, our compliance team needs the following items tied specifically to your SOC 2 Type II for the 2026 audit period: 

- The SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is acceptable).
- A bridge letter that clarifies the audit window and any control changes since the report (if available).
- Targeted evidence beyond the report:
  * MFA rotation/change logs for service and privileged accounts covering 2026 (csv export or samples).
  * Authn/access logs (time-stamped) for a 7-day slice in Q4 2026 demonstrating failed/successful MFA and SSO events.
  * A sample export of the quarterly access review for admin/privileged roles (PDF or spreadsheet).

Deliverables can be pseudonymized for user IDs, but timestamps and event types must be preserved. Please also confirm the exact audit window covered by your 2026 Type II so we can map control testing dates to our risk timeline.

Can you confirm the estimated delivery date and upload method (secure link or SFTP)? If helpful, I can share the minimal set of fields our control reviewers need.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Security Manager, Starlit Health
priya.menon@starlithealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@starlithealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + targeted control extracts

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested; here's what we propose and a few clarifying questions so we scope correctly:

Planned deliverables (tentative):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (2026) — we can deliver by 2027-03-23.
- Bridge letter clarifying scope/audit window and any post-report control changes — draft by 2027-03-23, final after your review.
- MFA rotation samples: a CSV showing rotation events for privileged/service accounts (we'll include key columns: account_id (pseudonymized), rotation_type, rotated_by_role, timestamp). Planned delivery 2027-03-24.
- Authn log slice: 7-day slice from 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-14 (suggested) including event_type, timestamp, source_ip, and outcome. We can pseudonymize user identifiers. Delivery method: secure Drive folder with restricted view + audit log, or SFTP if your team prefers.
- Access review snapshot: Quarterly reviewer exports (redacted) as XLSX.

Clarifying questions:
1) For the authn slice, do you need the full token/session payloads or just the event metadata?
2) For MFA rotation, are you looking for automated rotation records (system events) or manual change events as well?

I'll coordinate the log extraction with Karthik (infra) and Grace (security ops). Once you confirm the preferred date window and whether pseudonymization is sufficient, we'll finalize the delivery plan.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Jonas/team —

I'll own the authn slice extraction and the access review snapshot. Karthik, can you confirm that we can produce the 7-day slice for 2026-11-08 — 2026-11-14 with the fields Jonas listed? We need to know:

- Retention policy impact: are any of those older entries archived to cold storage?
- Expected pseudonymization approach: do we hash user IDs (sha256) or map to incremental IDs?

If infra needs S3 lifecycle access, I can open the change window this week. Plan: compile artifacts into a secured Drive link and attach the bridge letter draft so Priya can review.

Grace O'Connor
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Roe <daniel.roe@starlithealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@starlithealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + targeted control extracts

Thanks Jonas — a couple quick notes from the control team: 

- Pseudonymization is fine; we need consistent mapping across all artifacts (so we can trace an admin ID in the access review to events in the authn slice). A salted SHA256 hash is preferred.
- For authn slices, include MFA outcome (success/failure), SSO provider indicator, and whether the event was interactive or service-to-service. We don't need full token payloads.
- For MFA rotation evidence, show both automated rotations and exceptions where manual interventions occurred.

Preferred delivery: secure Drive folder with viewer access and a short manifest file describing each file (field names, timestamps, redaction applied). If you can, include a signed bridge letter in PDF form.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Daniel
Lead, Vendor Security Reviews
Starlit Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@starlithealth.com>, Daniel Roe <daniel.roe@starlithealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + targeted control extracts

Priya / Daniel — thanks for the confirmation. Final agreed delivery plan below: 

Deliverables and dates
- 2026 SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF) — delivery: 2027-03-23 (attached: SOC2-TypeII-2026-redacted.pdf).
- Draft bridge letter (PDF) clarifying audit window (2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31) and noting no material control changes since report — draft attached (bridge-letter-20270321.pdf).
- MFA rotation log sample (pseudonymized, salted SHA256 mapping) covering automated and manual rotation events for 2026 — delivery: 2027-03-24 (attached sample: mfa-rotation-log-sample.csv).
- Authn log slice 2026-11-08 -> 2026-11-14 (fields: timestamp, event_type, source_ip, sso_provider, mfa_outcome, pseudonymized_user_id, interactive_flag) — delivery: 2027-03-24.
- Access review snapshot (Q4 2026 reviewer export, redacted) — delivery: 2027-03-24 (attached: access-review-snapshot.xlsx).

Delivery method: secured Google Drive folder with restricted viewer links and an audit log of downloads. We'll include a manifest file describing pseudonymization and the map salt (salt not shared — mapping irreversible per your preference). If you require SFTP instead, let me know and Karthik will provision a short-lived account.

Next steps:
- Grace to upload artifacts to the secured folder and notify when ready.
- Priya / Daniel: confirm that the 7-day slice dates and pseudonymization approach work for your reviewers.

If everything looks good I'll follow up with the Drive link and a signed PDF of the bridge letter.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
